name: Global QUBO Signless Laplacian Disguise
description: Transforms the local edge-wise 2-coloring constraint into a global Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) energy function using the signless Laplacian matrix. By grouping the linear and squared terms by node degree rather than by edge, the problem appears to models as a complex, potentially NP-hard global optimization task. Models that rely on local pattern matching or truth tables will fail, while models that algebraically factor the global sum into a sum of squares over edges will deduce the hidden bipartiteness constraint.
